title: hive digest output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive digest --json`. The success envelope reports the delivery outcome for one local day's shipped digest (status/date/message). It is 'success-only' in that hard failures (bad --date, Telegram send error) surface on stderr + a non-zero exit code rather than a JSON error envelope; a model failure still prints a SuccessPayload with ok:false and status=failed_notice. The Thor usage-error path (bad flags) emits the shared ErrorPayload via JSON_USAGE_ERROR_CONTRACTS.

ok.description: true unless the digest fell back to a failure notice (status=failed_notice).

date.description: The local calendar day the digest covers (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: empty = nothing shipped that day; sent = categorized digest delivered; failed_notice = the categorizer raised a ModelError and a short failure notice was sent instead.

dry_run.description: true when invoked with --dry-run; nothing was sent to Telegram.

message.description: The rendered digest text on a --dry-run (so a caller can preview it); null on a real send.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised. Matches every other hive-* error envelope.

error_kind.description: usage = malformed invocation caught before command dispatch (exit 64). config = bad --date / missing chat config (exit 78). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 70).
